breakdown.description: The prompt replaces the spatially varying area with its arithmetic mean and calls the result exact, even though the deformation integral depends on 1/A(x), not on the average area itself.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification repeats and follows the incorrect instruction from the incomplete prompt — it replaces the varying area A(x) with the arithmetic mean A_mean = 325 mm² and uses δ = P·L/(A_mean·E). The ground truth requires evaluating the integral δ = ∫[0→L] P/(A(x)E) dx directly without substituting a mean area. The agent failed to fix this inconsistency and instead perpetuated the flawed approximation.
